title.zh: 卷六十四 表第四 方鎮一
title.raw: 卷六十四 表第四 方鎮一 Volume 64 Tables 4: Military Commanderies 1

sentences.zh: 高祖、太宗之制，兵列府以居外，將列衛以居內，有事則將以征伐，事已各解而去。

translations.literal: Under the institutions of Gaozu and Taizong, armies were arrayed through prefectures to dwell outside, while generals were arrayed through guards to dwell within; when there was need the generals undertook campaigns, and when the affair was done each disbanded and departed.
translations.idiomatic: Under the systems of Emperors Gaozu and Taizong, troops were stationed in prefectural armies posted outside the capital, while commanders were grouped in guard units stationed within; when need arose the generals would campaign, and once the task was finished each force disbanded and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 兵者，將之事也，使得以用，而不得以有之。

translations.literal: Soldiers are the matter of generals; they were enabled to use them, yet not enabled to possess them.
translations.idiomatic: Troops belonged to the generals' command—they could deploy them in service, but not claim them as their own.

sentences.zh: 及其晚也，土地之廣，人民之衆，城池之固，器甲之利，舉而予之。

translations.literal: When it reached its later period, the breadth of land, the multitude of people, the solidity of walled cities, and the sharpness of armor and weapons—all were raised up and given away.
translations.idiomatic: By the dynasty's later days, vast territories, large populations, fortified cities, and superior arms were all handed over wholesale.

sentences.zh: 何慮於其始也深，而易於其後也忽，如此之異哉？

translations.literal: Why was consideration at the beginning so deep, yet change in the later period so sudden—how such a difference!
translations.idiomatic: Why was precaution so thorough at the outset, yet reform so abruptly abandoned afterward—what a striking contrast!

sentences.zh: 豈其弊有漸，馴而致之，勢有不得已而然哉？

translations.literal: Was it not that the evil had a gradual course, and was tamed until it arrived—were there circumstances that could not be avoided and made it so?
translations.idiomatic: Perhaps the decline came by degrees, gently leading to this end—was it not a situation that could scarcely have been otherwise?

sentences.zh: 方鎮之患，始也各專其地以自世，旣則迫於利害之謀，故其喜則連衡而叛上，怒則以力而相并，又其甚則起而弱王室。

translations.literal: The affliction of the military prefectures: at first each monopolized its territory to perpetuate itself; once that was done, pressed by schemes of gain and loss, when pleased they joined in alliance and rebelled against the sovereign, when angered they used force to annex one another; at its most extreme they rose up and weakened the royal house.
translations.idiomatic: The trouble with the frontier commanderies began when each clique monopolized its region as a hereditary fief; once entrenched and driven by calculations of profit and loss, they allied against the throne when it suited them, fought one another by force when provoked, and at worst rose up to enfeeble the imperial house.

sentences.zh: 唐自中世以後，收功弭亂，雖常倚鎮兵，而其亡也亦終以此，可不戒哉！

translations.literal: From the mid-period of Tang onward, though success in quelling disorder was often achieved by relying on commandery troops, its fall too ultimately ended because of this—can one not take warning!
translations.idiomatic: From the mid-Tang period onward, though the court often drew on frontier armies to restore order and secure victory, the dynasty's fall too ultimately stemmed from this very reliance—should we not take warning!

translations.idiomatic: The compilers drew up the table of military commanderies.

translations.idiomatic: In 728, the sixteenth year of Kaiyuan, the Dada Hun Protectorate was abolished.

translations.literal: 732, twentieth year. The Shuofang circuit added the frontier tribes overseer and the imperial stud, palace parks, and pasture overseer to its concurrent duties.
translations.idiomatic: In 732, the twentieth year of Kaiyuan, the Shuofang military commissioner also took charge of frontier tribal oversight and the imperial stud, palace parks, and pasture commissioner.

translations.literal: 733, twenty-first year.
translations.idiomatic: 733 CE, twenty-first year.

sentences.zh: 734 二十二年 朔方節度兼關內道採訪處置使，增涇、原、寧、慶、隴、鄜、坊、丹、延、會、宥、麟十二州，以匡、長二州隸慶州，安樂二州隸原州。

translations.literal: 734, twenty-second year. The Shuofang circuit concurrently held the Guannei circuit investigation and disposal commissioner; it added twelve prefectures—Jing, Yuan, Ning, Qing, Long, Fu, Fang, Dan, Yan, Hui, You, and Lin; Kuang and Chang prefectures—two in all—were placed under Qing Prefecture; An and Le prefectures—two in all—were placed under Yuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 734, the twenty-second year of Kaiyuan, the Shuofang military commissioner also served as Guannei investigation and disposal commissioner, gaining twelve prefectures (Jing, Yuan, Ning, Qing, Long, Fu, Fang, Dan, Yan, Hui, You, and Lin); Kuang and Chang were assigned to Qing Prefecture, and An and Le to Yuan Prefecture.

translations.idiomatic: In 741, the twenty-ninth year of Kaiyuan, the Shuofang military commissioner concurrently held the Six Cities water transport commissioner.

sentences.zh: 756 至德元載 置京畿節度使，領京兆、同、岐、金、商五州。

translations.literal: 756, first year of the Zhide era. The Capital Region military commissioner was established, holding five prefectures—Jingzhao, Tong, Qi, Jin, and Shang.
translations.idiomatic: In 756, the first year of Zhide, the Capital Region military commissioner was established, commanding Jingzhao, Tong, Qi, Jin, and Shang prefectures.

sentences.zh: 是年，以金、商、岐州隸興平鳳翔，同州隸河中。

translations.literal: In the same year, Jin, Shang, and Qi prefectures were placed under Xingping Fengxiang, and Tong Prefecture under Hezhong.
translations.idiomatic: That same year, Jin, Shang, and Qi prefectures were assigned to Xingping Fengxiang, and Tong Prefecture to Hezhong.

sentences.zh: 別置關內節度使以代採訪使，徙治安化郡。

translations.literal: A separate Guannei military commissioner was established to replace the investigation commissioner; the seat was moved to Anhua Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: A separate Guannei military commissioner was installed in place of the investigation commissioner, with the seat moved to Anhua Commandery.

sentences.zh: 置東畿觀察使，領懷、鄭、汝、陝四州，尋以鄭州隸淮西。

translations.literal: The Eastern Capital Region observation commissioner was established, holding Huai, Zheng, Ru, and Shan prefectures—four in all; soon Zheng Prefecture was placed under Huaixi.
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern Capital Region observation commissioner was established, commanding Huai, Zheng, Ru, and Shan prefectures; soon Zheng Prefecture was transferred to Huaixi.

translations.literal: 757, second year.
translations.idiomatic: 757 CE, second year.

sentences.zh: 758 乾元元年 置振武節度押藩落使，領鎮北大都護府、麟勝二州。

translations.literal: 758, first year of the Qianyuan era. The Zhenwu military commissioner with frontier-tribal oversight was established, holding the Zhenbei Grand Protectorate and Lin and Sheng prefectures—two in all.
translations.idiomatic: In 758, the first year of Qianyuan, the Zhenwu military commissioner with frontier-tribal oversight was established, commanding the Zhenbei Grand Protectorate and Lin and Sheng prefectures.

sentences.zh: 陝州隸陝虢華節度，汝州隸豫許汝節度。

translations.literal: Shan Prefecture was placed under the Shan-Guo-Hua circuit, and Ru Prefecture under the Yu-Xu-Ru circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Shan Prefecture was assigned to the Shan–Guo–Hua circuit, and Ru Prefecture to the Yu–Xu–Ru circuit.

sentences.zh: 759 二年 置邠寧節度使，領州九：邠、寧、慶、涇、原、鄜、坊、丹、延。

translations.literal: 759, second year. The Bin-Ning military commissioner was established, holding nine prefectures: Bin, Ning, Qing, Jing, Yuan, Fu, Fang, Dan, and Yan.
translations.idiomatic: In 759, the second year of Qianyuan, the Bin–Ning military commissioner was established, commanding nine prefectures: Bin, Ning, Qing, Jing, Yuan, Fu, Fang, Dan, and Yan.

sentences.zh: 置陝虢華節度，領潼關防禦、團練、鎮守等使，治陝州。

translations.literal: The Shan-Guo-Hua circuit was established, holding the Tong Pass defense, training, and garrison commissioners and the like; seat at Shan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Shan–Guo–Hua circuit was established, commanding the Tong Pass defense, training, and garrison commissioners, with its seat at Shan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 760 上元元年 置興鳳隴節度使。

translations.literal: 760, first year of the Shangyuan era. The Xing-Feng-Long military commissioner was established.
translations.idiomatic: In 760, the first year of Shangyuan, the Xing–Feng–Long military commissioner was established.

translations.literal: Ceased holding Fu, Fang, Dan, and Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Relinquished Fu, Fang, Dan, and Yan prefectures.

sentences.zh: 置渭北鄜坊節度使，治坊州，並領丹、延二州。

translations.literal: The Wei-Bei Fu-Fang military commissioner was established, with seat at Fang Prefecture, also holding Dan and Yan prefectures—two in all.
translations.idiomatic: The Wei–Bei Fu–Fang military commissioner was established at Fang Prefecture, also commanding Dan and Yan prefectures.

sentences.zh: 改陝虢華節度為陝西節度，兼神策軍使，尋置觀察使。

translations.literal: The Shan-Guo-Hua circuit was renamed the Shanxi West circuit, concurrently holding the Divine Strategy Army commissioner; soon an observation commissioner was established.
translations.idiomatic: The Shan–Guo–Hua circuit was renamed the Shanxi West circuit and given concurrent command of the Divine Strategy Army; an observation commissioner was soon added.

sentences.zh: 761 二年 以華州置鎮國節度，亦曰關東節度。

translations.literal: 761, second year. At Hua Prefecture the Zhenguo circuit was established, also called the Guandong circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 761, the second year of Shangyuan, the Zhenguo circuit was established at Hua Prefecture, also known as the Guandong circuit.

sentences.zh: 廢關內節度使，罷領單于大都護，以涇、原、寧、慶、坊、丹、延隸邠寧節度，麟、勝隸振武節度。

translations.literal: The Guannei military commissioner was abolished and ceased holding the Chanyu Grand Protectorate; Jing, Yuan, Ning, Qing, Fang, Dan, and Yan were placed under the Bin-Ning circuit, and Lin and Sheng under the Zhenwu circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Guannei military commissioner was abolished and stripped of the Chanyu Grand Protectorate; Jing, Yuan, Ning, Qing, Fang, Dan, and Yan were assigned to Bin–Ning, and Lin and Sheng to Zhenwu.

translations.literal: The Shanxi West circuit ceased holding Hua Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Shanxi West military commissioner relinquished Hua Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 762 寶應元年 京畿節度使復領金、商。

translations.literal: 762, first year of the Baoying era. The Capital Region military commissioner again held Jin and Shang.
translations.idiomatic: In 762, the first year of Baoying, the Capital Region military commissioner regained Jin and Shang prefectures.

translations.literal: In the same year, the military commissioner was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: That same year, the military commissioner was abolished.

sentences.zh: 朔方節度復兼單于大都護，罷河中、振武節度，以所管七州隸朔方。

translations.literal: The Shuofang circuit again concurrently held the Chanyu Grand Protectorate; the Hezhong and Zhenwu circuits were abolished, and the seven prefectures under their command were placed under Shuofang.
translations.idiomatic: The Shuofang military commissioner again concurrently held the Chanyu Grand Protectorate; the Hezhong and Zhenwu circuits were abolished, and their seven prefectures were assigned to Shuofang.

sentences.zh: 陝西觀察使增領都防禦使。

translations.literal: The Shanxi West observation commissioner added the chief defense commissioner to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Shanxi West observation commissioner gained the chief defense commissioner in his duties.

sentences.zh: 763 廣德元年 罷鎮國軍節度。

translations.literal: 763, first year of the Guangde era. The Zhenguo Army circuit was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In 763, the first year of Guangde, the Zhenguo Army military commissioner was abolished.

sentences.zh: 懷州隸昭義，陝西觀察使增領虢州。

translations.literal: Huai Prefecture was placed under Zhaoyi; the Shanxi West observation commissioner added Guo Prefecture to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: Huai Prefecture was assigned to the Zhaoyi circuit, and the Shanxi West observation commissioner gained Guo Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 764 二年 置京畿觀察使，以御史中丞兼之。

translations.literal: 764, second year. The Capital Region observation commissioner was established, held concurrently by the vice censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In 764, the second year of Guangde, the Capital Region observation commissioner was established, filled concurrently by the vice censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 朔方節度復兼單于大都護，罷河中、振武節度，以所管七州隸朔方。

translations.literal: The Shuofang circuit again concurrently held the Chanyu Grand Protectorate; the Hezhong and Zhenwu circuits were abolished, and the seven prefectures under their command were placed under Shuofang.
translations.idiomatic: The Shuofang military commissioner again concurrently held the Chanyu Grand Protectorate; the Hezhong and Zhenwu circuits were abolished, and their seven prefectures were assigned to Shuofang.

translations.literal: The Eastern Capital Region observation commissioner was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern Capital Region observation commissioner was abolished.

sentences.zh: 765 永泰元年 以御史大夫兼京畿觀察使。

translations.literal: 765, first year of the Yongtai era. The censor-in-chief concurrently held the Capital Region observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In 765, the first year of Yongtai, the censor-in-chief concurrently held the Capital Region observation commissioner.

sentences.zh: 渭北鄜坊節度使罷領丹、延二州，增領綏州，以丹、延二州別置都團練使，治延州。

translations.literal: The Wei-Bei Fu-Fang military commissioner ceased holding Dan and Yan prefectures—two in all—and added Sui Prefecture to its jurisdiction; a separate chief training commissioner was established for Dan and Yan prefectures, with seat at Yan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Wei–Bei Fu–Fang military commissioner relinquished Dan and Yan, gained Sui Prefecture, and a separate chief training commissioner was established for Dan and Yan at Yan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 是年，增領安塞軍使，尋升為觀察使。

translations.literal: In the same year, the Anse Army commissioner was added to its jurisdiction; soon it was promoted to observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: That same year the Anse Army commissioner was added to its duties; soon the post was raised to observation commissioner.

translations.idiomatic: In 768, the third year of Dali, the Jing–Yuan military commissioner was established, with its seat at Jing Prefecture.

translations.literal: The Bin-Ning military commissioner was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Bin–Ning military commissioner was abolished.

translations.idiomatic: In 770, the fifth year of Dali, the Jing–Yuan military commissioner Ma Lin complained that the land was poor and army granaries inadequate, and was given remote jurisdiction over Zheng and Ying prefectures.

translations.idiomatic: In 771, the sixth year of Dali, the Wei–Bei Fu–Fang military commissioner was renamed the Wei–Bei military commissioner, regained Dan and Yan prefectures, and the Dan–Yan observation commissioner was abolished.

sentences.zh: 罷渭北節度，置都團練觀察使。

translations.literal: The Wei-Bei circuit was abolished; a chief training and observation commissioner was established.
translations.idiomatic: The Wei–Bei military commissioner was abolished and replaced by a chief training and observation commissioner.

sentences.zh: 析置河中、振武、邠寧三節度，朔方所領靈鹽夏豐四州、西受降城、定遠天德二軍。

translations.literal: Three circuits were carved out and established—Hezhong, Zhenwu, and Bin-Ning; what Shuofang held were Ling, Yan, Xia, and Feng prefectures—four in all—plus West Accept-the-Surrender Fortress, and the Dingyuan and Tiande armies—two in all.
translations.idiomatic: Hezhong, Zhenwu, and Bin–Ning were established as separate circuits, leaving Shuofang with four prefectures—Ling, Yan, Xia, and Feng—along with West Accept-the-Surrender Fortress and the Dingyuan and Tiande garrisons.

sentences.zh: 振武節度復領鎮北大都護府及綏銀二州、東中二受降城。

translations.literal: The Zhenwu circuit again held the Zhenbei Grand Protectorate and Sui and Yin prefectures—two in all—and the East and Central Accept-the-Surrender fortresses—two in all.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhenwu military commissioner regained the Zhenbei Grand Protectorate, Sui and Yin prefectures, and the eastern and central Accept-the-Surrender fortresses.

sentences.zh: 復置東畿觀察使，以留臺御史中丞兼之，復領汝州，廢陝西防禦觀察使。

translations.literal: The Eastern Capital Region observation commissioner was restored; the Left Censorate vice censor-in-chief at the eastern capital held the post concurrently; it again held Ru Prefecture; the Shanxi West defense and observation commissioner was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern Capital Region observation commissioner was reinstated, filled concurrently by the Left Censorate vice censor-in-chief at Luoyang; Ru Prefecture was restored to his command and the Shanxi West defense and observation commissioner was abolished.

translations.literal: 780, first year of the Jianzhong era.
translations.idiomatic: 780 CE, first year of the Jianzhong reign.

sentences.zh: 781 二年 鄭州隸永平節度。

translations.literal: 781, second year. Zheng Prefecture was placed under the Yongping circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 781, the second year of Jianzhong, Zheng Prefecture was assigned to the Yongping circuit.

translations.literal: Ru Prefecture was placed under Heyang; soon the former arrangement was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Ru Prefecture was transferred to Heyang; soon the previous arrangement was restored.

translations.literal: The Shanxi West defense commissioner was restored.
translations.idiomatic: The Shanxi West defense commissioner was reinstated.

translations.literal: The Heyang Three Cities military commissioner was established.
translations.idiomatic: The Heyang Three Cities military commissioner was established.

sentences.zh: 以東都畿觀察使兼之，領懷、鄭、汝、陝四州，尋置使，增領東畿五縣及衛州，亦曰懷衛節度使。

translations.literal: The Eastern Capital Region observation commissioner held it concurrently, commanding Huai, Zheng, Ru, and Shan prefectures—four in all; soon a commissioner was established who added the five Eastern Capital Region counties and Weizhou to his jurisdiction, also called the Huaiwei military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern Capital Region observation commissioner held the post concurrently, commanding Huai, Zheng, Ru, and Shan prefectures; soon a dedicated commissioner was appointed who also took the five Eastern Capital Region counties and Weizhou, also known as the Huaiwei military commissioner.

translations.literal: 782, third year.
translations.idiomatic: 782 CE, third year.

sentences.zh: 783 四年 置京畿渭南節度觀察使，領金、商二州。

translations.literal: 783, fourth year. The Capital Region Wei-Nan military and observation commissioner was established, holding Jin and Shang prefectures—two in all.
translations.idiomatic: In 783, the fourth year of Jianzhong, a Capital Region Wei–Nan military and observation commissioner was created, commanding Jin and Shang prefectures.

sentences.zh: 是年，兼渭北、鄜坊、丹、延、綏五州。

translations.literal: In the same year, he concurrently held Wei-Bei, Fu-Fang, Dan, Yan, and Sui prefectures—five in all.
translations.idiomatic: That same year he also took charge of Wei–Bei, Fu–Fang, Dan, Yan, and Sui—five prefectures in all.

sentences.zh: 未幾，罷五州及金州，為京畿商州節度使。

translations.literal: Before long, the five prefectures and Jin Prefecture were abolished; he became military commissioner of the Capital Region Shang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Before long those five prefectures and Jin were removed from his charge; the post became military commissioner of the Capital Region Shang Prefecture circuit.

sentences.zh: 興鳳隴節度賜號保義節度。

translations.literal: The Xing-Feng-Long circuit was granted the title Baoyi circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Xing–Feng–Long military commissioner was given the honorific name Baoyi circuit.

sentences.zh: 是年，罷保義，以隴州置奉義軍節度使，尋廢。

translations.literal: In the same year, Baoyi was abolished; the Long Prefecture Fengyi Army military commissioner was established; soon it was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: That same year the Baoyi circuit was abolished and a Fengyi Army military commissioner was created at Long Prefecture; before long this too was abolished.

sentences.zh: 復置渭北節度，如上元之舊，尋罷。

translations.literal: The Wei-Bei circuit was restored, as in the old Shangyuan arrangement; soon it was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Wei–Bei military commissioner was restored on the old Shangyuan model; before long it was abolished again.

sentences.zh: 未幾復置，徙治鄜州，其後置都團練觀察防禦使。

translations.literal: Before long it was restored again; the seat was moved to Fu Prefecture; afterward a chief training, observation, and defense commissioner was established.
translations.idiomatic: Before long it was reinstated with its seat moved to Fu Prefecture; later a chief training, observation, and defense commissioner was appointed.

sentences.zh: 罷觀察，置東畿汝州節度。

translations.literal: The observation commissioner was abolished; the Eastern Capital Region Ru Prefecture circuit was established.
translations.idiomatic: The observation post was abolished and an Eastern Capital Region Ru Prefecture military commissioner was installed.

sentences.zh: 置陝西都防禦使，尋升為節度使。

translations.literal: The Shanxi West chief defense commissioner was established; soon he was promoted to military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: A Shanxi West chief defense commissioner was appointed and soon raised to military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 784 興元元年 罷京畿節度使，以同州為奉誠軍節度，領同、晉、慈、隰四州。

translations.literal: 784, first year of the Xingyuan era. The Capital Region military commissioner was abolished; at Tong Prefecture the Fengcheng Army circuit was established, holding Tong, Jin, Ci, and Xi prefectures—four in all.
translations.idiomatic: In 784, the first year of Xingyuan, the Capital Region military commissioner was abolished; the Fengcheng Army circuit was established at Tong Prefecture, commanding Tong, Jin, Ci, and Xi prefectures.

sentences.zh: 是年罷，以華州置潼關節度使。

translations.literal: In the same year it was abolished; at Hua Prefecture the Tong Pass military commissioner was established.
translations.idiomatic: That same year it was abolished, and the Tong Pass military commissioner was established at Hua Prefecture.

translations.literal: The Shanxi West military commissioner was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Shanxi West military commissioner was abolished.

sentences.zh: 785 貞元元年 保義節度增領臨洮軍使。

translations.literal: 785, first year of the Zhenyuan era. The Baoyi circuit added the Lintao Army commissioner to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In 785, the first year of Zhenyuan, the Baoyi circuit gained the Lintao Army commissioner in its jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 廢東都畿汝州節度，置都防禦使，以東都留守兼之，增領唐、鄧二州。

translations.literal: The Eastern Capital Region Ru Prefecture circuit was abolished; a chief defense commissioner was established, held concurrently by the Eastern Capital guardian, who added Tang and Deng prefectures—two in all—to his jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern Capital Region Ru Prefecture circuit was abolished; a chief defense commissioner was appointed, filled concurrently by the Eastern Capital guardian, who also gained Tang and Deng prefectures.

sentences.zh: 置陝虢都防禦使，治陝州。

translations.literal: The Shan-Guo chief defense commissioner was established, with seat at Shan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Shan–Guo chief defense commissioner was established, with its seat at Shan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 踰月，又為都防禦觀察陸運使。

translations.literal: After a month, he also became chief defense, observation, and overland transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: After a month, the post was expanded to chief defense, observation, and overland transport commissioner.

sentences.zh: 罷河陽節度，置都團練使。

translations.literal: The Heyang circuit was abolished; a chief training commissioner was established.
translations.idiomatic: The Heyang circuit was abolished and replaced by a chief training commissioner.

sentences.zh: 786 二年 升東都畿汝州都防禦使為都防禦觀察使。

translations.literal: 786, second year. The Eastern Capital Region Ru Prefecture chief defense commissioner was promoted to chief defense and observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In 786, the second year of Zhenyuan, the Eastern Capital Region Ru Prefecture chief defense commissioner was raised to chief defense and observation commissioner.

sentences.zh: 787 三年 罷保義節度，置都團練觀察防禦使。

translations.literal: 787, third year. The Baoyi circuit was abolished; a chief training, observation, and defense commissioner was established.
translations.idiomatic: In 787, the third year of Zhenyuan, the Baoyi circuit was abolished and a chief training, observation, and defense commissioner was installed.

sentences.zh: 未幾，復置節度，兼右神策軍行營節度使。

translations.literal: Before long, the circuit was restored; he concurrently held the Right Divine Strategy Army campaign military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the military commissioner was reinstated, concurrently commanding the Right Divine Strategy Army campaign.

sentences.zh: 初，隴右節度兵入屯秦州，尋徙岐州，及吐蕃陷隴右，德宗置行秦州，以刺史兼隴右經略使，治普潤，以鳳翔節度使領隴右支度營田觀察使。

translations.literal: Initially, the Longyou circuit troops entered and encamped at Qin Prefecture; soon they moved to Qi Prefecture. When the Tibetans seized Longyou, Dezong established Acting Qin Prefecture, with the prefect concurrently holding the Longyou pacification commissioner, with seat at Purun; the Fengxiang military commissioner held the Longyou supply, garrison-fields, and observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: At first Longyou troops were posted at Qin Prefecture and soon shifted to Qi; after the Tibetans overran Longyou, Dezong created an Acting Qin Prefecture whose prefect doubled as Longyou pacification commissioner at Purun, while the Fengxiang military commissioner took charge of Longyou supply, garrison-fields, and observation duties.

sentences.zh: 復置渭北節度使，以綏州隸銀夏節度。

translations.literal: The Wei-Bei military commissioner was restored; Sui Prefecture was placed under the Yin-Xia circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Wei–Bei military commissioner was reinstated, and Sui Prefecture was assigned to the Yin–Xia circuit.

sentences.zh: 置夏州節度觀察處置押蕃落使，領綏、鹽二州，其後罷領鹽州。

translations.literal: The Xia Prefecture military, observation, disposal, and frontier-tribal overseer commissioner was established, holding Sui and Salt prefectures—two in all; afterward Salt Prefecture was removed from its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: A Xia Prefecture military commissioner with frontier-tribal oversight was created, commanding Sui and Salt prefectures; later Salt Prefecture was withdrawn from his charge.

translations.literal: Tang and Deng prefectures—two in all—were placed under the Shannan East circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Tang and Deng prefectures were transferred to the Shannan East circuit.

translations.literal: 788, fourth year.
translations.idiomatic: 788 CE, fourth year.

sentences.zh: 789 五年 罷東都畿汝州觀察使，置都防禦使，汝州別置防禦使。

translations.literal: 789, fifth year. The Eastern Capital Region Ru Prefecture observation commissioner was abolished; a chief defense commissioner was established, and a separate defense commissioner was established for Ru Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 789, the fifth year of Zhenyuan, the Eastern Capital Region Ru Prefecture observation commissioner was abolished; a chief defense commissioner was installed, and a separate defense commissioner was created for Ru Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 790 六年 涇原節度領四鎮北庭行軍節度使。

translations.literal: 790, sixth year. The Jing-Yuan circuit held the Four Garrisons and Beiting campaign military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In 790, the sixth year of Zhenyuan, the Jing–Yuan military commissioner took charge of the Four Garrisons and Beiting campaign military commissioner.

translations.literal: 791, seventh year.
translations.idiomatic: 791 CE, seventh year.

translations.literal: 792, eighth year.
translations.idiomatic: 792 CE, eighth year.

translations.literal: 793, ninth year. The Tong Pass circuit was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In 793, the ninth year of Zhenyuan, the Tong Pass circuit was abolished.

translations.literal: 794, tenth year.
translations.idiomatic: 794 CE, tenth year.

translations.literal: 795, eleventh year.
translations.idiomatic: 795 CE, eleventh year.

sentences.zh: 796 十二年 朔方節度罷領豐州及西受降城、天德軍，以振武之東、中二受降城隸天德軍，以天德軍置都團練防禦使，領豐會二州、三受降城。

translations.literal: 796, twelfth year. The Shuofang circuit ceased holding Feng Prefecture, West Accept-the-Surrender Fortress, and the Tiande Army; the eastern and central Accept-the-Surrender fortresses of Zhenwu were placed under the Tiande Army; a chief training and defense commissioner was established at the Tiande Army, holding Feng and Hui prefectures—two in all—and the three Accept-the-Surrender fortresses.
translations.idiomatic: In 796, the twelfth year of Zhenyuan, Shuofang relinquished Feng Prefecture, West Accept-the-Surrender Fortress, and the Tiande Army; Zhenwu's eastern and central Accept-the-Surrender fortresses were assigned to Tiande, where a chief training and defense commissioner was established commanding Feng and Hui prefectures and the three Accept-the-Surrender fortresses.

sentences.zh: 復置河陽懷節度，治河陽。

translations.literal: The Heyang-Huai circuit was restored, with seat at Heyang.
translations.idiomatic: The Heyang–Huai circuit was reinstated, with its seat at Heyang.

translations.literal: 797, thirteenth year.
translations.idiomatic: 797 CE, thirteenth year.

translations.literal: 798, fourteenth year.
translations.idiomatic: 798 CE, fourteenth year.

translations.literal: 799, fifteenth year.
translations.idiomatic: 799 CE, fifteenth year.

translations.literal: 800, sixteenth year.
translations.idiomatic: 800 CE, sixteenth year.

translations.literal: 801, seventeenth year.
translations.idiomatic: 801 CE, seventeenth year.

translations.literal: 802, eighteenth year.
translations.idiomatic: 802 CE, eighteenth year.

translations.literal: 803, nineteenth year.
translations.idiomatic: 803 CE, nineteenth year.

translations.literal: 804, twentieth year.
translations.idiomatic: 804 CE, twentieth year.

translations.literal: 805, first year of the Yongzhen era.
translations.idiomatic: 805 CE, first year of the Yongzhen reign.

sentences.zh: 806 元和元年 升隴右經略使為保義節度，尋罷保義，復舊名。

translations.literal: 806, first year of the Yuanhe era. The Longyou pacification commissioner was promoted to the Baoyi circuit; soon Baoyi was abolished and the former name restored.
translations.idiomatic: In 806, the first year of Yuanhe, the Longyou pacification commissioner was raised to the Baoyi circuit; soon Baoyi was abolished and the former title restored.

sentences.zh: 是年，增領靈臺、良原、崇信三鎮。

translations.literal: In the same year, Lingtai, Liangyuan, and Chongxin—three garrisons—were added to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: That same year, the garrisons of Lingtai, Liangyuan, and Chongxin were added to its jurisdiction.

translations.literal: A defense commissioner was carved out and established at Dan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: A defense commissioner was established by carving out Dan Prefecture.

translations.literal: 807, second year.
translations.idiomatic: 807 CE, second year.

sentences.zh: 808 三年 罷東都畿汝州都防禦使。

translations.literal: 808, third year. The Eastern Capital Region Ru Prefecture chief defense commissioner was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In 808, the third year of Yuanhe, the Eastern Capital Region Ru Prefecture chief defense commissioner was abolished.

sentences.zh: 809 四年 涇原節度增領行渭州。

translations.literal: 809, fourth year. The Jing-Yuan circuit added Acting Wei Prefecture to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In 809, the fourth year of Yuanhe, the Jing–Yuan military commissioner gained jurisdiction over Acting Wei Prefecture.

translations.literal: 810, fifth year.
translations.idiomatic: 810 CE, fifth year.

translations.literal: 811, sixth year.
translations.idiomatic: 811 CE, sixth year.

translations.literal: 812, seventh year.
translations.idiomatic: 812 CE, seventh year.

translations.literal: 813, eighth year.
translations.idiomatic: 813 CE, eighth year.

sentences.zh: 814 九年 夏州節度增領宥州。

translations.literal: 814, ninth year. The Xia Prefecture circuit added You Prefecture to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In 814, the ninth year of Yuanhe, the Xia Prefecture military commissioner gained jurisdiction over You Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 河陽節度增領汝州，徙治汝州。

translations.literal: The Heyang circuit added Ru Prefecture to its jurisdiction and moved its seat to Ru Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Heyang military commissioner gained Ru Prefecture and moved its seat to Ru Prefecture.

translations.literal: 815, tenth year.
translations.idiomatic: 815 CE, tenth year.

translations.literal: 816, eleventh year.
translations.idiomatic: 816 CE, eleventh year.

translations.literal: 817, twelfth year.
translations.idiomatic: 817 CE, twelfth year.

sentences.zh: 818 十三年 汝州隸東畿，復置東都畿汝州都防禦使，兼東都留守如故，罷河陽節度。

translations.literal: 818, thirteenth year. Ru Prefecture was placed under the Eastern Capital Region; the Eastern Capital Region Ru Prefecture chief defense commissioner was restored, concurrently held by the Eastern Capital guardian as before, and the Heyang circuit was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In 818, the thirteenth year of Yuanhe, Ru Prefecture was assigned to the Eastern Capital Region; the Eastern Capital Region Ru Prefecture chief defense commissioner was reinstated, still filled concurrently by the Eastern Capital guardian, and the Heyang circuit was abolished.

translations.literal: 819, fourteenth year.
translations.idiomatic: 819 CE, fourteenth year.

translations.literal: 820, fifteenth year.
translations.idiomatic: 820 CE, fifteenth year.

sentences.zh: 821 長慶元年 東都畿防禦罷領汝州。

translations.literal: 821, first year of the Changqing era. The Eastern Capital Region defense commissioner ceased holding Ru Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 821, the first year of Changqing, the Eastern Capital Region defense commissioner relinquished Ru Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 822 二年 東都畿復領汝州。

translations.literal: 822, second year. The Eastern Capital Region again held Ru Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 822, the second year of Changqing, the Eastern Capital Region regained Ru Prefecture.

translations.literal: 823, third year.
translations.idiomatic: 823 CE, third year.

translations.literal: 824, fourth year.
translations.idiomatic: 824 CE, fourth year.

translations.literal: 825, first year of the Baoli era.
translations.idiomatic: 825 CE, first year of the Baoli reign.

translations.literal: 826 CE, second year.
translations.idiomatic: 826 CE, second year.

translations.literal: 827, first year of the Dahe era.
translations.idiomatic: 827 CE, first year of the Dahe reign.

translations.literal: 828, second year.
translations.idiomatic: 828 CE, second year.

sentences.zh: 829 三年 以陝虢地近京師，罷陝虢都防禦使。

translations.literal: 829, third year. Because Shan-Guo territory was near the capital, the Shan-Guo chief defense commissioner was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In 829, the third year of Dahe, because Shan–Guo territory lay near the capital, the Shan–Guo chief defense commissioner was abolished.

translations.literal: 830, fourth year.
translations.idiomatic: 830 CE, fourth year.

translations.literal: 831, fifth year.
translations.idiomatic: 831 CE, fifth year.

translations.literal: 832, sixth year.
translations.idiomatic: 832 CE, sixth year.

sentences.zh: 833 七年 以銀州刺史領銀川監牧使。

translations.literal: 833, seventh year. The Yin Prefecture prefect took charge of the Yinchuan pasture overseer.
translations.idiomatic: In 833, the seventh year of Dahe, the Yin Prefecture prefect was made overseer of the Yinchuan pastures.

translations.literal: 834, eighth year.
translations.idiomatic: 834 CE, eighth year.

translations.literal: 835, ninth year.
translations.idiomatic: 835 CE, ninth year.

sentences.zh: 836 開成元年 復置陝虢都防禦觀察使。

translations.literal: 836, first year of the Kaicheng era. The Shan-Guo chief defense and observation commissioner was restored.
translations.idiomatic: In 836, the first year of Kaicheng, the Shan–Guo chief defense and observation commissioner was reinstated.

translations.literal: 837, second year.
translations.idiomatic: 837 CE, second year.

sentences.zh: 838 三年 夏州節度使領採造供軍、銀川監牧使。

translations.literal: 838, third year. The Xia Prefecture military commissioner held the timber-cutting and army supply commissioner and the Yinchuan pasture overseer.
translations.idiomatic: In 838, the third year of Kaicheng, the Xia Prefecture military commissioner took charge of timber-cutting and army supply and the Yinchuan pasture overseer.

translations.literal: 839, fourth year.
translations.idiomatic: 839 CE, fourth year.

translations.literal: 840, fifth year.
translations.idiomatic: 840 CE, fifth year.

translations.literal: 841, first year of the Huichang era.
translations.idiomatic: 841 CE, first year of the Huichang reign.

sentences.zh: 842 二年 天德軍使賜號歸義軍節度使，尋廢。

translations.literal: 842, second year. The Tiande Army commissioner was granted the honorific name Guiyi Army military commissioner; soon it was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In 842, the second year of Huichang, the Tiande Army commissioner was granted the honorific name Guiyi Army military commissioner; soon it was abolished.

sentences.zh: 843 三年 改單于大都護為安北都護。

translations.literal: 843, third year. The Chanyu Grand Protectorate was renamed the Anbei Grand Protectorate.
translations.idiomatic: In 843, the third year of Huichang, the Chanyu Grand Protectorate was renamed the Anbei Grand Protectorate.

sentences.zh: 復置河陽節度，徙治孟州。

translations.literal: The Heyang circuit was restored; the seat was moved to Meng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Heyang military commissioner was reinstated, with its seat moved to Meng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 844 四年 河陽節度增領澤州。

translations.literal: 844, fourth year. The Heyang circuit added Ze Prefecture to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In 844, the fourth year of Huichang, the Heyang military commissioner gained jurisdiction over Ze Prefecture.

translations.literal: 845, fifth year.
translations.idiomatic: 845 CE, fifth year.

translations.literal: 846, sixth year.
translations.idiomatic: 846 CE, sixth year.

translations.literal: 847, first year of the Dazhong era.
translations.idiomatic: 847 CE, first year of the Dazhong reign.

translations.literal: 848, second year.
translations.idiomatic: 848 CE, second year.

sentences.zh: 849 三年 邠寧節度以南山平夏部落叛，徙治寧州，及內附，復徙故治。

translations.literal: 849, third year. Because the Pingxia tribes of the southern mountains rebelled, the Bin-Ning circuit moved its seat to Ning Prefecture; when they submitted, the seat was moved back to the former location.
translations.idiomatic: In 849, the third year of Dazhong, because the Pingxia tribes of the southern mountains rebelled, the Bin–Ning military commissioner moved its seat to Ning Prefecture; when they submitted, the seat returned to its former location.

translations.literal: 850, fourth year. Qin Prefecture was added to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In 850, the fourth year of Dazhong, Qin Prefecture was added to its jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 851 五年 罷領隴州，以隴州置防禦使，領黃頭軍使。

translations.literal: 851, fifth year. Long Prefecture was removed from its jurisdiction; a defense commissioner was established at Long Prefecture, holding the Huangtou Army commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In 851, the fifth year of Dazhong, Long Prefecture was withdrawn from its command; a defense commissioner was established at Long Prefecture, commanding the Huangtou Army commissioner.

translations.literal: Wu Prefecture was added to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Prefecture was added to its jurisdiction.

translations.literal: 852, sixth year.
translations.idiomatic: 852 CE, sixth year.

translations.literal: 853, seventh year.
translations.idiomatic: 853 CE, seventh year.

sentences.zh: 854 八年 朔方節度增領威州。

translations.literal: 854, eighth year. The Shuofang circuit added Wei Prefecture to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In 854, the eighth year of Dazhong, the Shuofang military commissioner gained jurisdiction over Wei Prefecture.

translations.literal: 855, ninth year.
translations.idiomatic: 855 CE, ninth year.

sentences.zh: 856 十年 夏州節度使增領撫平党項等使。

translations.literal: 856, tenth year. The Xia Prefecture military commissioner added the commissioner for pacifying the Dangxiang and others to his duties.
translations.idiomatic: In 856, the tenth year of Dazhong, the Xia Prefecture military commissioner also took charge of pacifying the Dangxiang and related peoples.

sentences.zh: 864 五年 秦州隸天雄軍節度。

translations.literal: 864, fifth year. Qin Prefecture was placed under the Tianxiong Army circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 864, the fifth year of Xiantong, Qin Prefecture was assigned to the Tianxiong Army circuit.

translations.idiomatic: 880 CE, first year of the Guangming reign.

translations.literal: 881, first year of the Zhonghe era.
translations.idiomatic: 881 CE, first year of the Zhonghe reign.

sentences.zh: 882 二年 渭北節度賜號保大軍節度，增領翟州，以延州置保塞軍節度。

translations.literal: 882, second year. The Wei-Bei circuit was granted the honorific name Baoda Army circuit, Zhai Prefecture was added to its jurisdiction, and at Yan Prefecture the Case Army circuit was established.
translations.idiomatic: In 882, the second year of Zhonghe, the Wei–Bei military commissioner was granted the honorific name Baoda Army circuit, gained Zhai Prefecture, and the Case Army circuit was established at Yan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 夏州節度賜號定難節度。

translations.literal: The Xia Prefecture circuit was granted the honorific name Dingnan circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Xia Prefecture military commissioner was granted the honorific name Dingnan circuit.

sentences.zh: 883 三年 隴州防禦使增京甸神勇軍使。

translations.literal: 883, third year. The Long Prefecture defense commissioner added the Capital Region Divine Valor Army commissioner to his duties.
translations.idiomatic: In 883, the third year of Zhonghe, the Long Prefecture defense commissioner also took charge of the Capital Region Divine Valor Army commissioner.

sentences.zh: 升陝虢防禦觀察使為節度使。

translations.literal: The Shan-Guo defense and observation commissioner was promoted to military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Shan–Guo defense and observation commissioner was raised to military commissioner.

translations.literal: 884, fourth year.
translations.idiomatic: 884 CE, fourth year.

sentences.zh: 885 光啟元年 邠寧節度賜號靜難軍節度。

translations.literal: 885, first year of the Guangqi era. The Bin-Ning circuit was granted the title Jingnan Army circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 885, the first year of Guangqi, the Bin–Ning military commissioner was given the honorific name Jingnan Army circuit.

translations.literal: The Eastern Capital Region observation commissioner concurrently holding the frontier-suppression commissioner was established.
translations.idiomatic: An Eastern Capital Region observation commissioner with concurrent frontier-suppression duties was appointed.

translations.literal: 886, second year.
translations.idiomatic: 886 CE, second year.

sentences.zh: 887 三年 升東畿觀察兼防遏使為佑國軍節度。

translations.literal: 887, third year. The Eastern Capital Region observation commissioner who concurrently held the frontier suppression commissioner was promoted to the Youguo Army circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 887, the third year of Guangqi, the Eastern Capital Region observation commissioner who also held the frontier suppression commissioner was raised to the Youguo Army circuit.

translations.literal: 888, first year of the Wende era.
translations.idiomatic: 888 CE, first year of the Wende reign.

sentences.zh: 889 龍紀元年 賜陝虢節度為保義軍節度。

translations.literal: 889, first year of the Longji era. The Shan-Guo circuit was granted the title as Baoyi Army circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 889, the first year of Longji, the Shan–Guo military commissioner was renamed the Baoyi Army circuit.

translations.literal: 890, first year of the Dashun era.
translations.idiomatic: 890 CE, first year of the Dashun reign.

translations.literal: 891 CE, second year.
translations.idiomatic: 891 CE, second year.

translations.literal: 892, first year of the Jingfu era.
translations.idiomatic: 892 CE, first year of the Jingfu reign.

translations.literal: 893, second year.
translations.idiomatic: 893 CE, second year.

sentences.zh: 894 乾寧元年 以乾州置威勝軍節度。

translations.literal: 894, first year of the Qianning era. At Qian Prefecture the Weisheng Army circuit was established.
translations.idiomatic: In 894, the first year of Qianning, the Weisheng Army circuit was established at Qian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 鳳翔節度增領乾州，未幾罷。

translations.literal: The Fengxiang circuit added Qian Prefecture to its jurisdiction; before long this was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Fengxiang military commissioner gained Qian Prefecture; before long this arrangement was abolished.

sentences.zh: 涇原節度賜號彰義軍節度，增領渭、武二州。

translations.literal: The Jing-Yuan circuit was granted the honorific name Zhangyi Army circuit and added Wei and Wu prefectures—two in all—to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Jing–Yuan military commissioner was granted the honorific name Zhangyi Army circuit and gained Wei and Wu prefectures.

translations.literal: Ru Prefecture was placed under the Zhongwu Army circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Ru Prefecture was assigned to the Zhongwu Army circuit.

sentences.zh: 895 二年 升同州為匡國軍節度。

translations.literal: 895, second year. Tong Prefecture was promoted to the Kuangguo Army circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 895, the second year of Qianning, Tong Prefecture was raised to the Kuangguo Army circuit.

translations.literal: 896, third year.
translations.idiomatic: 896 CE, third year.

translations.literal: 897, fourth year.
translations.idiomatic: 897 CE, fourth year.

sentences.zh: 898 光化元年 以華州置鎮國軍節度，領華、同二州，兼興德尹。

translations.literal: 898, first year of the Guanghua era. At Hua Prefecture the Zhenguo Army circuit was established, holding Hua and Tong prefectures—two in all, concurrently holding the Xingde Governor.
translations.idiomatic: In 898, the first year of Guanghua, the Zhenguo Army circuit was established at Hua Prefecture, commanding Hua and Tong prefectures and concurrently holding the Xingde governorship.

sentences.zh: 更保塞軍節度曰寧塞軍節度，後又更名衛國軍節度。

translations.literal: The Case Army circuit was renamed the Ningse Army circuit; later it was again renamed the Weiguo Army circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Case Army circuit was renamed the Ningse Army circuit, and later renamed again as the Weiguo Army circuit.

sentences.zh: 罷丹州防禦使，以丹州隸衛國軍。

translations.literal: The Dan Prefecture defense commissioner was abolished; Dan Prefecture was placed under the Weiguo Army circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Dan Prefecture defense commissioner was abolished, and Dan Prefecture was assigned to the Weiguo Army circuit.

translations.literal: 899, second year.
translations.idiomatic: 899 CE, second year.

sentences.zh: 900 三年 罷鎮國軍節度及興德尹。

translations.literal: 900, third year. The Zhenguo Army circuit and the Xingde Governor were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In 900, the third year of Guanghua, the Zhenguo Army circuit and the Xingde governorship were abolished.

sentences.zh: 復置東畿觀察使兼防遏使。

translations.literal: The Eastern Capital Region observation commissioner who concurrently held the frontier suppression commissioner was restored.
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern Capital Region observation commissioner who also held the frontier suppression commissioner was reinstated.

translations.literal: The Youguo Army circuit was established.
translations.idiomatic: The Youguo Army circuit was established.

translations.literal: The Heyang circuit ceased holding Ze Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Heyang military commissioner relinquished Ze Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 901 天復元年 升隴州防禦使為保勝節度使。

translations.literal: 901, first year of the Tianfu era. The Long Prefecture defense commissioner was promoted to Baosheng military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In 901, the first year of Tianfu, the Long Prefecture defense commissioner was raised to Baosheng military commissioner.

translations.literal: 902, second year.
translations.idiomatic: 902 CE, second year.

translations.literal: 903, third year.
translations.idiomatic: 903 CE, third year.

sentences.zh: 904 天祐元年 以京畿置佑國軍節度使，領金、商二州。

translations.literal: 904, first year of the Tianyou era. In the Capital Region the Youguo Army military commissioner was established, holding Jin and Shang prefectures—two in all.
translations.idiomatic: In 904, the first year of Tianyou, the Youguo Army military commissioner was established in the Capital Region, commanding Jin and Shang prefectures.

sentences.zh: 罷東畿觀察使兼防遏使。

translations.literal: The Eastern Capital Region observation commissioner who concurrently held the frontier suppression commissioner was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern Capital Region observation commissioner who also held the frontier suppression commissioner was abolished.

translations.literal: 905, second year.
translations.idiomatic: 905 CE, second year.

sentences.zh: 906 三年 置義勝軍節度使，領耀、鼎二州，罷匡國軍。

translations.literal: 906, third year. The Yisheng Army military commissioner was established, holding Yao and Ding prefectures—two in all, and the Kuangguo Army circuit was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In 906, the third year of Tianyou, the Yisheng Army military commissioner was established, commanding Yao and Ding prefectures, and the Kuangguo Army circuit was abolished.

translations.literal: 907, fourth year.
translations.idiomatic: 907 CE, fourth year.
